---
title: "Greenland and Antarctic ice-sheet maps"
---

Interactive maps and A0 posters of the Greenland and Antarctic ice sheets:
surface ice velocity over hillshaded topography, with drainage regions, surface
contours, the median sea-ice edge, key numbers and place names. They are made
with Julia and CairoMakie; the code is on
[GitHub](https://github.com/fesmc/cryosphere-maps), and
[Data & methods](about.qmd) lists the sources and how the maps are made.

## Interactive maps

::: {.grid}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
### [Greenland →](greenland.qmd)
Ice velocity, surface and bed elevation at 500 m, with drainage regions,
contours, sea-ice edges and all glacier names (GeoNames). Search for a name to
find it.
:::
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
### [Antarctica →](antarctica.qmd)
The same at 1 km, with drainage basins, the grounding line and the glaciers,
ice streams, ice shelves and domes of the SCAR Composite Gazetteer.
:::
:::
